# Timing outliers (generated by experiments/outliers.py)

1700 timed runs. A run is compared with the median of the repetitions of the same instance and algorithm. Overall 1.3% of runs are more than 1.5 times their median and 0.1% more than 2 times.

| family | runs | above 1.5x median | above 2x median | worst run / median | mean / median (typical instance) |

| random_sparse | 250 | 4.4% | 0.0% | 1.8 (Edmonds-Karp, x = 100, seed 0) | 1.02 |
| random_dense | 250 | 1.2% | 0.4% | 5.2 (Edmonds-Karp, x = 100, seed 0) | 1.01 |
| density_sweep | 300 | 0.0% | 0.0% | 1.3 (Ford-Fulkerson, x = 0.9, seed 0) | 1.00 |
| matching_unit | 250 | 1.2% | 0.4% | 2.7 (Edmonds-Karp, x = 800, seed 2) | 1.01 |
| capacity_sweep | 250 | 2.0% | 0.0% | 2.0 (Ford-Fulkerson, x = 10000, seed 3) | 1.01 |
